dedupe_keys.name: istat census sections basi territoriali with population households dwellings and residential buildings 1991 to 2021

description: ISTAT publishes the territorial bases of the Italian censuses of 1991, 2001, 2011 and 2021 on one page: the boundaries of census sections, census areas, sub-municipal areas and localities, with the census variables that attach to them. The 2021 census section shapefiles, one per region plus a national KMZ, carry the resident population, number of households, total number of dwellings and number of residential buildings of each section, with its perimeter and area. For 1991, 2001 and 2011 separate files hold the definitive variables of the population and housing censuses (XLS and CSV) and of the industry and services census by section, and the 2021 variables of the permanent census are a regional download of about 254 MB. The page was last updated on 14 May 2026. Format and access: ZIP archives of shapefiles in WGS84 UTM zone 32N, KMZ, XLS and CSV, free to download, with a PDF that defines every field. Licence: the ISTAT legal notice puts site content under CC BY 4.0 unless stated otherwise; free. Caveats: section codes and boundaries change between censuses, the 2021 permanent census mixes registers and sample surveys, and the 2021 section attributes are counts only, with no age or type of building. Simulation uses: building and dwelling counts at the finest census unit for exposure mapping, disaggregation of demand and service planning. Related records: IPUMS International, the European building stock observatory and the GHSL built-up and population grids.
